title: 18 suspects in Haitian president's 2021 killing to be extradited to US
text:
Eighteen suspects in Haitian President Jovenel Moïse’s 2021 assassination are set to be extradited to the United States.

Jason Reding Quiñones, U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Florida, said that 30 suspects in the assassination had been indicted, and 18 of those were being transported to the U.S. in a military plane.
